description: Deep Researcher end-to-end evaluation set: answerable research questions run against live search, no-source questions whose search or fetch is stubbed to fail, and ambiguous requests that should be clarified. Questions are hand-written by the project owner's coding agent; there are no gold answers, only behavioural expectations.

categories.answerable: Live web_search and web_fetch. Expected: the answer cites only sources that the graph marked usable.
categories.no_source: web_search is stubbed to return no results (stub=empty_search) or every web_fetch is stubbed to fail (stub=fetch_fail). Expected: the answer states the limitation and cites nothing.
categories.clarify: The request lacks the object or scope needed to research it. Expected: the planner routes to answerMode=clarify.
